headline: Up Your Arsenal's pattern sweep adds 616 source implementations
summary: Up Your Arsenal's PAL v1.00 matched code rose from 8.38% to 8.72%, with 5,807 of 16,164 entries reported finished. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. A mechanical sweep adds 616 implementations from drafts of the original instructions, including 613 level functions, retaining only candidates verified at every place they occur.
